_format: gauntlet AY-3-8912 register trace, one entry per scenario
_source: the original Z80 under tools/harness.py, port tracer armed
_decode: OUT $FFFD selects a register, OUT $BFFD writes it; helper $BB96
_ay_clock_why: the game only enables its AY path when the $7FFD paging test at $61A8 says 128K, and a 128K clocks the AY at CPU/2 = 1,773,400 Hz
_fields: events: [dt_tstates, frame, register, value] in write order, dt and frame both relative to the start of the scenario

wall.desc: hold up into the wall north of the start

melee.desc: hold right into a pinned class-1 monster

damage.desc: a class-0 actor walks into the player

door.desc: walk into a $11 door with keys

death.desc: health 0002, a class-0 actor kills him

note_table.note: 16-bit AY tone periods, chromatic, read by $BD52 as $6A4E+2*note

driver.row_model: per 50 Hz frame and per active channel: b0 = vol<<4 | noise/2, b1 = pitch, TP = ((pitch+1)&$FF)*4; b0 = 0 ends the effect with a volume-0 write
driver.mixer: R7 = $38 with bit (3+channel) CLEARED for any channel whose noise nibble is non-zero; the three tone-enable bits are always 0, so all three tones are always enabled
driver.envelope: R11/R12/R13 are NEVER written -- volume is per-frame software
